name: Crystals and oscillators
summary: Quartz crystals and resonators that set the clock in radios, computers and timers.
uses: Building or repairing radios and clocks
identify: Small metal cans (oval HC-49 or tiny cylinders) or ceramic blocks marked with a frequency like 16.000 or 32.768, next to every microcontroller and radio chip.
test: Hard to test without an oscilloscope. Check for cracks and broken legs, and try it in a known-good circuit.
